name: fleet
description: Your claude agents list in a side pane, with optional cones columns

spinner.title: Spinner
spinner.description: Animate working rows as Claude Code does; off saves about 2% CPU with four sessions working

statusMin.title: Status width
statusMin.description: Columns kept for the status text; long names shrink first

width.title: Pane width
width.description: Share of the terminal the docked pane takes, in percent; 0 leaves Claude Code's own width. Dragging the pane edge still wins

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: Seconds between checks for changed sessions; the list itself reloads only on a change, or every 30 s

showModel.title: Model column
showModel.description: The model a background session runs

showEffort.title: Effort column
showEffort.description: The effort level a background session runs at

showTokens.title: Tokens column
showTokens.description: Tokens a background session has used

showTasks.title: Tasks column
showTasks.description: Background tasks a session has running

showContext.title: Context column
showContext.description: Context used of the window, from the statusLine report cones reads

showCost.title: Cost column
showCost.description: Session cost, from the statusLine report cones reads

showCpu.title: CPU column
showCpu.description: The session process's CPU, as ps reports it

showMemory.title: Memory column
showMemory.description: The session process's resident memory, as ps reports it
